description: This Java class 'ServiceMcaRule' defines rules for mail service conditions and actions within the Apache Ofbiz framework. It includes logic for evaluating conditions and executing actions if conditions are met, based on XML configuration input.

classes.name: ServiceMcaRule
classes.description: Represents a mail service condition-action rule, capable of evaluating conditions and executing associated actions.

methods.name: ServiceMcaRule
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule with XML configuration.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the rule's conditions and executes actions if all are true.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the rule is enabled.
